In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the SEG-NMT model outperforms the NMT model by 0.5-1.0 BLEU score on the En-Fr, En-De, and En-Es language pairs.
we have shown that it is possible to use a black box search engine for retrieving relevant sentence pairs and then use them to improve the translation quality of NMT models.
we have proposed a novel approach that can leverage a large parallel corpus for translation.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
our approach can improve translation quality by using a search engine to retrieve relevant sentence pairs from the training data.
the proposed approach can be used to improve the quality of a translation model without any additional training.
the proposed approach can be seen as a way of combining NMT with a retrieval based approach.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the search engine guided approach can be used to improve the translation quality of NMT models even after the models are trained.
the search engine guided NEMT model can be used as a drop in replacement for the baseline NMT model.
